subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the reference character sheet of the anime girl Fengjin, showing front, left, back, right views, a face close-up, and detail references.
<Subject 1> is Fengjin from <Picture 1>: a young anime girl with fluffy pastel-pink hair in two round buns, a teal heart-shaped ahoge on top, a deep-red jeweled flower hair accessory on one side, and large teal-gradient eyes; she wears a red-and-white heart-themed frilly dress with white puffy short sleeves, white lace gloves, long pink ribbons down her back, and red Mary-Jane shoes. She is rendered non-realistically in a 3D-rendered-2D-anime (cel-shaded) look: flat cel colors, crisp outlines, simple anime features.
<Subject 2> is Little Ika from <Picture 2>: a chubby, round, fluffy white baby-pony creature with a pink tuft on its forehead, a tiny gold crown, teal-blue curly mane and tail, pink inner ears, small white wings, teal hoof tips, and a teal bowtie with a shell-shaped center. CRITICAL: it has NO mouth at all — only two round dark dot eyes and pink cheek blush; never draw a mouth, beak, or any lip line on its face.
<Subject 3> is a bright photorealistic bathroom: white wall tiles, a shallow white bathtub filled with warm water, a faucet, soft fluffy towels in pink and white, and warm daylight through a frosted window.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second warm bathing scene in which <Subject 1>, using her exact appearance from <Picture 1>, washes <Subject 2>, the mouthless chubby white pony from <Picture 2>, in the warm water of <Subject 3>. In strict order she rinses it with cupped water, lathers soap and gently scrubs its fur, rinses the foam off, lifts it out and dabs it dry, then holds the towel-wrapped pony up toward the camera with a gentle smile. Both characters keep their reference designs; Little Ika never grows a mouth, and Fengjin never shows more than two hands.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - Fengjin's pink bun hair, teal heart ahoge, red flower hair accessory, teal eyes, red-and-white frilly dress, gloves and red shoes are all retained in cel-shaded style.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - Little Ika's round white body, pink tuft, gold crown, teal curly mane and tail, small wings, teal bowtie, dot eyes and pink blush are retained; the absence of a mouth is preserved in every shot.
<Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: fully_preserved - the sheets guide both characters' proportions, features and costume from every angle.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the photorealistic tiled bathroom, shallow tub, warm water and soft towels stay consistent.

detailed_description:
A non-realistic cel-shaded anime girl and her mouthless chubby pony sit inside a photorealistic bright bathroom: true-to-life tiles, warm water, real splashes and steam, contrasted against flat anime shading and crisp outlines. Fengjin has exactly two hands; each hand holds only one object at a time and the free hand is always visible at her side or on the named prop — never render a third hand or extra fingers. Facial expressions stay simple and warm; Little Ika's dot eyes and pink blush never gain a mouth. Beat-cut editing with soft motion makes the scene gentle and cozy.
[Shot 1] Medium shot of <Subject 3>, the sunlit bathroom. <Subject 1> kneels beside a shallow white tub half-filled with warm, gently rippling water; <Subject 2> sits in the shallow water, its round body submerged up to the belly. Both of Fengjin's hands dip under the water, cup a scoop, and rise; she tilts her cupped hands so warm water pours in a soft stream over Little Ika's back. Little Ika's two dot eyes blink once slowly, its tiny wings giving one contented twitch. Expression: Fengjin wears a gentle, warm smile, eyes open. Sound sync: soft water-lap and a gentle pouring stream.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, close-up on the tub edge. Fengjin's LEFT hand picks up a small pump soap bottle, her RIGHT hand presses one pump to dispense a little soap onto her palm; her LEFT hand immediately sets the bottle down on the counter and lets go, then her RIGHT hand joins it as they rub her palms together to build fluffy white foam. With both hands she gently presses and rubs the foam over Little Ika's forehead tuft and round back; fluffy bubbles puff up around it. Little Ika's dot eyes squint into two happy closed arcs. Sound sync: one pump squirt, then soft rub-rub foam sounds.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, rinse. Fengjin cups clean warm water in both hands again and pours it slowly over Little Ika; the suds slide off in pale foamy streams and a few water droplets sparkle through the air. Little Ika's tiny wings give two small happy flutters. The camera holds a brief soft slow motion on one falling droplet, then returns to real time. Expression: Fengjin's smile stays soft and focused. Sound sync: pouring water, a light splash, and soft droplet plinks.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, Fengjin lifts Little Ika out of the water: her RIGHT hand slides under its round belly while her LEFT hand supports its back, and she sets it gently on a fluffy pink towel spread on the counter. She picks up a white towel with both hands and lightly pats and dabs Little Ika's fur dry, in small gentle pats. Little Ika sits round and still, dot eyes calm and happy. Sound sync: a soft wet plop as it is set down, then fluffy towel pat-pats.
[Shot 5] At 00:12.500, clean front medium shot. Fengjin wraps Little Ika snugly in the fluffy towel so only its round white head, gold crown and teal mane poke out; she holds the bundled towel with BOTH hands and lifts it gently up toward the camera, presenting it proudly. Her eyes are open with a warm, gentle smile; Little Ika's dot eyes are wide and happy, pink cheeks blushing, still with no mouth. Soft warm steam rises around them. Sound sync: soft towel rustle, a tiny contented squeak from the water, and a gentle warm ambient hum; hold the shot until 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet warm bathroom room tone with faint running-water ambience runs throughout. All effects are action-synced and never precede or lag their visual: Shot 1 — soft water lap and a gentle pouring stream; Shot 2 — one soap-pump squirt and soft foam rubs; Shot 3 — rinsing pour, light splash and droplet plinks; Shot 4 — a soft wet set-down and fluffy towel pats; Shot 5 — towel rustle and a faint contented squeak.

non_diegetic_music:
A soft, cozy music-box lullaby at a slow tempo, with warm soft piano under it and gentle bells; it stays light and gentle throughout, swelling only a little at the final held shot, no loud beats or dramatic hits.
